startup.name: Acme
startup.appears_to_be: A collaborative release checklist for small software teams.
startup.audience: Small product teams preparing a customer-facing software release.
startup.problem: Release knowledge is spread across documents, chat, and issue trackers.
startup.promise: Give every launch one visible source of truth.
startup.mechanism: A shared checklist linked to owners, evidence, and release state.
startup.alternative: Spreadsheets, issue templates, and manual status meetings.
evidence_notes: Observed — The hero names release checklists and small teams.
Inferred — The product is intended to replace a manual coordination layer.
Unknown — Activation and retention are not visible from the public site.

verdict.label: Launch after critical fixes
verdict.summary: The product is understandable and usable, but its primary action needs a clearer next-step expectation.
verdict.biggest_risk: Visitors do not know whether the trial requires a team setup.
verdict.retest_condition: The CTA explains the commitment and reaches a working setup screen.

dimensions.name: Positioning clarity
dimensions.finding: The product and outcome are visible in the hero.
dimensions.recommendation: Name the release trigger more explicitly.

dimensions.name: Conversion path
dimensions.finding: The CTA is prominent and functional.

dimensions.name: Product proof
dimensions.finding: The interface is visible but outcomes are not.
dimensions.evidence: Workflow screenshot without a completed launch example.

dimensions.name: Trust and risk
dimensions.finding: Privacy exists but setup effort is unclear.
dimensions.evidence: Footer privacy link and missing onboarding details.
dimensions.recommendation: State setup time and required permissions.

dimensions.name: Experience quality
dimensions.finding: Hierarchy remains clear on desktop and mobile.

dimensions.name: Technical surface
dimensions.finding: Inspected public paths load and resolve.
dimensions.evidence: Homepage, pricing, privacy, and signup routes.

dimensions.name: Launch operations
dimensions.finding: Availability is clear but support expectations are not.
dimensions.evidence: Public launch badge and missing support response guidance.
dimensions.recommendation: Name the support channel and expected response.

journey.observation: The hero names the product and audience.
The workflow is explained with a product screen.
No completed launch example is shown.
Setup time and permissions are not stated.
journey.fix: Add a setup note beside the CTA.

journey.observation: The primary CTA reaches the signup route.
The post-click setup is not previewed.

improvements.title: Explain what happens after starting
improvements.evidence: The CTA says Start free without showing the next step.
improvements.change: Add a three-step onboarding preview immediately below the CTA.
improvements.validation: Measure CTA completion and setup completion separately.

improvements.title: Show a completed launch
improvements.evidence: The product screen contains an empty example.
improvements.change: Replace it with a realistic completed release checklist.

rewrites.after: Create a workspace in under two minutes
rewrites.reason: Sets a concrete expectation without changing the action.

plan.done_when: A visitor can explain who the product is for and what happens next.
The page demonstrates a realistic outcome.
Visitors can estimate effort and support.
The inspected journey works at common viewports.

strengths: The visual hierarchy is calm and readable.

experiment.hypothesis: A visible onboarding preview will increase completed workspace creation.
experiment.change: Add three setup steps below the primary CTA.
experiment.success_signal: A sustained relative improvement without more support requests

limitations: This fixture contains <script>alert('escaped')</script> to verify safe report output.
The public audit cannot establish product-market fit.
validation.legal_note: This is a preliminary public-experience audit, not legal, accessibility, privacy, or security certification.
